episodes.summary: The agents/ layer has: Orchestrator (multi-agent workflow pipelines), Coordinator (task delegation, shared memory, inter-agent messaging), AgentRuntime (sub-process spawner), RoleRegistry (built-in roles: architect, developer, qa, coordinator, pm + custom). Pipelines chain PM → Architect → Developer → QA with cross-validation between stages. Inter-agent messaging supports: result, review_request, review_response, clarification, approval, revision.

episodes.planGoal: Web: Wikipedia RAG — Definisi dan Konsep Dasar
episodes.summary: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) adalah teknik yang memungkinkan LLM mengambil informasi dari sumber data eksternal. Pertama kali diperkenalkan di paper Lewis et al. 2020. Proses: (1) Dokumen di-encode ke vector embeddings, (2) User query → document retriever cari dokumen relevan, (3) Dokumen + query jadi prompt ke LLM, (4) LLM generate output berdasarkan query dan retrieved documents. Hybrid search (vector + text search) bisa meningkatkan akurasi.

Agentic RAG di opencode-agentic-engine adalah hybrid proactive-agentic RAG. Beda dengan traditional RAG: (1) TF-IDF first, vector optional — sparse retrieval bukan dense embedding. (2) Category-segregated indices. (3) Confidence-aware scoring (0.0-1.0). (4) Multi-tool retrieval — agent punya 5+ retrieval tools. (5) Mandatory research flow jika confidence < 0.6. (6) Proactive auto-injection via system.transform hook + agentic refinement via tool calls.

tfidfDocs.content: Agentic RAG di opencode-agentic-engine adalah hybrid proactive-agentic RAG. Beda dengan traditional RAG: (1) TF-IDF first, vector optional — sparse retrieval bukan dense embedding. (2) Category-segregated indices. (3) Confidence-aware scoring (0.0-1.0). (4) Multi-tool retrieval — agent punya 5+ retrieval tools. (5) Mandatory research flow jika confidence < 0.6. (6) Proactive auto-injection via system.transform hook + agentic refinement via tool calls.
